lines: Feeling peckish? Need a break from the day?
Look no further; our kind leader recommends Der Traum.
The chef has mastered a range of delicacies, from aspic to pickled pigeon.
The quality rivals that of the most esteemed dishes, even more delectable than those of the Verehn's past.
Unlike the past, though, the owner is staunchly devoted to supporting Verehn's citizens, sharing their gifts to the people of our city.
After all, the leader requires only the best.
So, next time you feel an emptiness in your stomach, drop by Der Traum.
This message has been approved by our great leader, Svetka.
